text: Please can someone call me back. My stepson is 11 months and his temperature has gone up to 40. I've taken it three times now and it keeps saying 40. I'm really scared, I've never seen it that high. He's got nappy rash, his bum is red and sore looking, but I did the glass test on it and it goes white when I press, so I think that's just normal nappy rash? His dad is on nights and I can't get hold of him. I don't know what's normal for a baby this little and I don't want to get it wrong.
